title: Extraction and Debt
author: L. M. Kavanagh
blurb: Lior Amberdale, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
